common.comingSoon: This section will be available in an upcoming release.
common.serverRestarting: The server is restarting. Please try again in a moment.
common.networkError: Cannot reach the server. Check the network connection.

auth.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
auth.subtitle: Stock and inventory control
auth.unsentExplain_one: {{count}} count made on this device has not reached the server yet. It stays on this device and is sent when you sign in again and open that count.
auth.unsentExplain_other: {{count}} counts made on this device have not reached the server yet. They stay on this device and are sent when you sign in again and open that count.
auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.negativeHint: Check these in the next count

settings.title: Settings
settings.blindCountHint: A nudge toward honest counting, not a security control: staff can still see stock levels elsewhere.
settings.businessDayHint: Between closing and the next opening (e.g. 06:00): a count after midnight still belongs to the same day.

products.name: Name
products.packSizeHint: Fixed after the first receipt or count: a pack of another size is a new product.
products.minStockHint: Flagged as low when total stock is at or below this level. 0 = don't track.
products.weightHint: Reserved for counting open bottles by weight.
products.unitsLocked: Locked: the product is already used in documents or counts.
products.deactivateWarning: This product still has stock. Deactivating hides it from selection lists; its history is kept.

errors.bottleSize: Enter the bottle size in ml.
errors.packSize: Enter the pack size in grams.

locations.name: Name
locations.namePlaceholder: e.g. Main storage, Bar counter, Fridge
locations.deactivateWarning_one: {{count}} product still has stock here. The location will be hidden from new operations; history and balances are kept.
locations.deactivateWarning_other: {{count}} products still have stock here. The location will be hidden from new operations; history and balances are kept.

docs.dateHint: Leave empty if it happens now. If you record it later, set the real time: it decides whether a stock count already included this document.
docs.author: By
docs.pickProduct: Search product, SKU or scan barcode…
docs.reverseExplain: A reversal posts the exact opposite movements. The original stays in the history.

errors.product: Choose a product in every item.
errors.location: Choose a location in every item.
errors.qty: Enter a positive quantity in every item.

docs.posCompensation: Correction of a POS report after an inventory — open the report

inventory.startHint: Lists every product with a balance at this location. Other operations keep working during the count.
inventory.alreadyRunning: A count is already in progress at this location.
inventory.syncBeforeComplete: Some counts are not on the server yet. Completion is available once they are sent.
inventory.conflict: Someone else counted this item meanwhile. Check their number and recount if needed.
inventory.addHint: Found something that is not on the list? Pick it here to count it.
inventory.completeExplain: Counted quantities become the book stock. Items that were not counted keep their current stock.
inventory.zeroUncounted_one: Treat {{count}} uncounted item as zero (not found)
inventory.zeroUncounted_other: Treat {{count}} uncounted items as zero (not found)
inventory.zeroUncountedHint: Only if you are sure the shelf was checked for them.
inventory.cancelExplain: Stock does not change. The count stays in the history as cancelled.
inventory.pendingSalesTitle: POS sales not written off yet
inventory.pendingSales: No POS report has been written off at this location for: {{days}}. Upload them on the Sales (POS) page before completing, otherwise those sales show up as a shortage.

sales.explain: Upload the daily “sales by item” report from the POS (.xlsx). The app computes what the kitchen used by the norms and writes it off from stock with one click. Upload each day before completing a night count.
sales.fileHint: Exactly as the POS exported it, up to 2 MB
sales.dateHint: The file has no date: choose the business day of these sales. Default: the previous business day.

warnings.total_mismatch: The total row of the file says {{file_total}} items, the rows add up to {{sum}}. Check that the file is complete.
warnings.file_date_far: The file was created on {{created}}, far from the chosen day {{sales_date}}. Is the sales day right?

sales.coveredBy: Inventories at {{location}} counted all of this stock after these sales (first: #{{id}}), so nothing was written off. The report is kept for history.
sales.voidedNote: This report was voided. Its day can be uploaded again.
sales.unmappedExplainAdmin: Set a norm for kitchen items (e.g. a new burger). Mark drinks and other non-kitchen items as “not kitchen” so they stop showing up here.
sales.unmappedExplainStaff: An administrator has to set norms for these items or mark them as not kitchen. You can still write off the rest.
sales.pickLocation: Choose the location to write off from.
sales.noUsage: No sold item has a norm yet.
sales.ackUnmapped_one: Write off without the {{count}} item that has no norm
sales.ackUnmapped_other: Write off without the {{count}} items that have no norm
sales.voidExplainPosted: The write-off is reversed (stock comes back) and the day can be uploaded again. Products an inventory counted after these sales keep their counted stock.
sales.voidExplain: The report is set aside and the day can be uploaded again. Stock does not change.
sales.normExplain: What one sold unit uses. Changes apply to reports not written off yet; written-off reports keep their numbers.
sales.notKitchenLabel: Not kitchen (drinks etc.): never written off

preset.burger: Burger: 175 g fries + 200 g meat + bun

sales.posItemsExplain: Every item ever seen in a POS report. New items appear here after the first upload.
sales.noPosItems: No POS items yet: upload a POS report first.
sales.countedBy: Not written off: counted by inventory #{{id}} on {{at}}
sales.willBeSkipped: Will be skipped: inventory #{{id}} counted it on {{at}}, after these sales
sales.skipExplain_one: {{count}} product was already counted by an inventory after these sales; it is skipped so it is not taken off twice. The rest is written off.
sales.skipExplain_other: {{count}} products were already counted by an inventory after these sales; they are skipped so they are not taken off twice. The rest is written off.
sales.editHint: Quantities (in g, ml or pcs) can be corrected before writing off; the result is recalculated at once.
sales.correctHint: Change the quantities right in the table. Saving reverses this day's write-off and posts the corrected one on the same date. Products already counted by an inventory keep their counted stock: the difference goes into that count's result.
sales.preparedByHint: “Prepared by” is any name of who made the report
sales.countedAfterWrittenOff: Counted by inventory #{{id}} on {{at}}: corrections keep the counted stock
sales.countedEdit: Counted by an inventory after these sales: the stock after the count stays as counted; the difference moves between the sales and the count's result.
